description: This file defines the GetBucketLocationParser class, which extends AbstractParser to handle parsing responses for the GetBucketLocation operation in the AWS S3 SDK. It wraps a provided parser to add specific handling for response body data to determine the bucket's location.

classes.name: GetBucketLocationParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling the GetBucketLocation operation in AWS S3 responses, adding special handling for the location constraint extraction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that takes a parser callable to wrap.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the wrapped parser, and if the command is GetBucketLocation, adds handling to determine the location from the response body.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a member from a stream to the wrapped parser.
